deals.notes: Excerpts show only the proxy/N-14 and reminder letters for the 1 Nov 2019 meeting. The 2020 and 2021 DEF 14A excerpts are annual-meeting notices (VGI and ZTR) and state nothing about the ZF reorganization, so the outcome is not stated in the text provided.
